**1. Introduction

The Bhopal disaster, as you know, was a terrible thing that happened. Many people died. Many people were sick. The people in town don't live there any more. It was a bad thing, and the people in town will never forget it. 

 there is lots of talk about it now. Some people say the factory did it, and some people say the government did it. But who is right?
